text:
anya_marketing: Morning — aligning on the paid plan for the 'Cloud Inference' webinar. Need search + retarget orchestration, creative cadence, and lead routing. @sam_growth you good to own search setup? @diego_ads on retarget creative?
sam_growth: Yep, I can take search. Drafting keyword clusters now. Initial budget split idea: brand 40%, mid-funnel 35%, bottom/conv 25%.
diego_ads: For retargeting I want two creative sets: teaser carousel + short case-study video. Cadence idea — rotate daily for first 72h, then refresh one variant on day 7. A/B headlines for each creative.
anya_marketing: Preference is keep CPA cap at $25 for webinar signups week 1. If CTR > 3% on any segment we scale that segment.
mira_ops: Lead routing: I'll put a webhook to /webhooks/marketo-inbound. Add param source=paid_journey_2245 so CRM rules can tag program. Also need form field mapping: email, company, utm_campaign.
lisa_content: I'll produce 3 headline variants + 2 description lengths (short/long) by EOD tomorrow. Will include plain text and asset-ready PNGs.
campaign_bot: Campaign draft created — id: ci-webinar-2245 — status: draft, owner:@anya_marketing
sam_growth: UTMs for tracking — use this pattern so reporting lines up:
```
utm_source=google&utm_medium=cpc&utm_campaign=ci_webinar_2245&utm_term={keyword}&utm_content={creative_variant}
```
diego_ads: Audience windows? proposing 14d for site visitors, 30d for engaged video viewers. Frequency cap 3/day. Thoughts?
sam_growth: 14/30 sounds good. Also add a 7-day lookback for ad click retarget to capture warm late converters. Set creative tags like "teaser_v1", "case_vid_a" in the ad metadata.
anya_marketing: Timeline check — Search go-live Mon 8am PT, retarget start Tue 9am PT, pause paid ads 24h before webinar. QA checklist before activation: tracking pixels, webhook test, UTM validation, landing form submit test, GDPR consent banner present.
mira_ops: I'll run webhook + landing form test tomorrow 10am PT and share results here. Also will add a quick smoke test script for the team to run: `curl -X POST https://staging.example.com/webhook -d '{"email":"qa@example.com","source":"paid_journey_2245"}'`
anya_marketing: Nice. Also adding an event to calendar for ad check-in Mon 7:15am PT — invite sent.
lisa_content: Quick note on creative copy — avoid the phrase "cost-effective inference" in headlines, use "fast, reliable inference" instead.
diego_ads: Got it. I'll update ad copy and swap assets after first-day performance review.
sam_growth: Performance guardrails: if CPA > $40 for two consecutive days we throttle that segment by 30%. If CTR < 0.8% for brand terms we pause and re-evaluate keywords.
anya_marketing: Good rules. Who's owning post-click experiment? want a short form vs long form test on the landing page.
mira_ops: I'll create two routes in the webhook: /inbound/short-form and /inbound/long-form and tag leads accordingly so ops can see which converts.
campaign_bot: Reminder scheduled: run webhook smoke test tomorrow 10:00am PT — assigned mira_ops.
anya_marketing: OK we're set. Quick replies: everyone confirm final asset delivery ETA and I'll lock budgets by EOD. :thumbsup:
sam_growth: confirm — keywords + seeds by EOD today. :thumbsup:
diego_ads: confirm — creatives ready for first draft review by tomorrow noon. :rocket:
lisa_content: confirm — copy and assets by EOD tomorrow.
mira_ops: confirm — webhook and QA script run tomorrow 10am PT.
anya_marketing: Great — locking this thread. I'll post the final brief once budgets are entered. Thanks team! :tada:
